articles.title: Jet Fuel Costs a Record High, So Holiday Flights Cost More
articles.summary: Jet fuel hit a record $4.90 a gallon, so holiday plane tickets cost more — Thanksgiving fares are up about 30%, but most families are still booking.

articles.title: Oil Spill Reaches UAE Beaches and Moves Toward Turtle Islands
articles.summary: Oil from a damaged tanker has spread over 35 kilometres and reached UAE beaches, drifting toward protected islands where green turtles live.

articles.title: Young Candidates Who Rent Want to Make Homes Cheaper
articles.summary: Young candidates from both parties — renters in Connecticut and a 21-year-old lawmaker in Montana — are running on ideas to make homes cheaper to rent and buy.
